name: customers
definition: 购买或使用企业产品与服务的交易主体，具有客户细分与结算币种等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与加油站区分：加油站是销售发生的场所，客户是交易主体；与产品区分：产品是被购买的对象。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table customers; provenance: direct source customers

name: gasstations
definition: 提供燃油等商品零售服务的固定经营场所，具有所属连锁、国家与站点细分等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与客户区分：加油站是场所而非交易主体；与交易区分：交易是发生在加油站的活动。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table gasstations; provenance: direct source gasstations

name: products
definition: 可供销售的商品或服务项目，具有唯一标识与描述等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与交易区分：产品是被交易的对象，交易是产品被售出的过程。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table products; provenance: direct source products

name: transactions
definition: 在特定时间与地点发生的商品或服务售出事件，具有金额、单价、客户、站点与产品等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与客户区分：交易是事件，客户是参与交易的主体；与产品区分：交易是产品被售出的过程。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table transactions_1k; provenance: direct source transactions_1k

name: yearmonth
definition: 按客户与月份汇总的消费金额信息记录，具有客户标识、月份与消费额等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与交易区分：月度消费记录是汇总信息，交易是单笔事件。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table yearmonth; provenance: direct source yearmonth

name: CzechRepublicGasStation
definition: Gas stations located in the Czech Republic.

name: SlovakiaGasStation
definition: Gas stations located in Slovakia.

name: PremiumGasStation
definition: Gas stations classified in the premium segment.

name: DiscountGasStation
definition: Gas stations classified in the discount segment.

name: SMECustomer
definition: Customers belonging to the SME segment.

name: EURCustomer
definition: Customers whose currency is EUR.

name: CZKCustomer
definition: Customers whose currency is CZK.

name: TransactionAmount
definition: Number of items in a transaction.

name: TransactionPrice
definition: Total price paid in a transaction.

name: TransactionDate
definition: Date on which a transaction occurred.

name: TransactionTime
definition: Time at which a transaction occurred.

name: YearMonthConsumption
definition: Monthly gas consumption recorded per customer.

name: YearMonthDate
definition: Year-month identifier in the yearmonth table.

name: ProductDescription
definition: Description of a product.

name: EURtoCZKCustomerRatio
definition: Ratio of customers paying in EUR to customers paying in CZK. Formula: EURCustomer / CZKCustomer. Inputs: EURCustomer = customers.Currency WHERE Currency = 'EUR'; CZKCustomer = customers.Currency WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
aliases: ratio of EUR to CZK customers

name: SMECZKminusEUR
definition: Difference between SME customers paying in CZK and SME customers paying in EUR. Formula: SMECustomer_CZK - SMECustomer_EUR. Inputs: SMECustomer = customers.Segment WHERE Segment = 'SME'; CZKCustomer = customers.Currency WHERE Currency = 'CZK'; EURCustomer = customers.Currency WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
aliases: more SMEs pay in CZK than EUR
difference of SMEs paying CZK vs EUR

name: ConsumptionDifferenceCZKvsEUR2012
definition: Difference in total gas consumption in 2012 between CZK-paying and EUR-paying customers. Formula: YearMonthConsumption_CZK_2012 - YearMonthConsumption_EUR_2012. Inputs: YearMonthConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption; YearMonthDate = yearmonth.Date; CZKCustomer = customers.Currency WHERE Currency = 'CZK'; EURCustomer = customers.Currency WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
aliases: difference in gas consumption between CZK and EUR customers

name: PremiumPercentageSVK
definition: Percentage of premium gas stations among all gas stations in Slovakia. Formula: PremiumGasStation_SVK / AllGasStation_SVK * 100. Inputs: PremiumGasStation = gasstations.Segment WHERE Segment = 'Premium'; SlovakiaGasStation = gasstations.Country WHERE Country = 'SVK'
aliases: premium vs overall segment in SVK

name: DiscountGasStationDifferenceCZEminusSVK
definition: Difference in number of discount gas stations between Czech Republic and Slovakia. Formula: DiscountGasStation_CZE - DiscountGasStation_SVK. Inputs: DiscountGasStation = gasstations.Segment WHERE Segment = 'Discount'; CzechRepublicGasStation = gasstations.Country WHERE Country = 'CZE'; SlovakiaGasStation = gasstations.Country WHERE Country = 'SVK'
aliases: more discount gas stations in CZE than SVK
discount gas station difference cz eminus svk

name: AveragePricePerItem
definition: Average price per item purchased, computed as total price divided by total amount. Formula: TransactionPrice / TransactionAmount. Inputs: TransactionPrice = transactions_1k.Price; TransactionAmount = transactions_1k.Amount

name: TopSpendingCustomer
definition: Customer with the highest total transaction price. Formula: MAX(SUM(TransactionPrice)) per CustomerID. Inputs: TransactionPrice = transactions_1k.Price

name: CustomerConsumptionAboveThresholdPercentage
definition: Percentage of customers whose consumption exceeds a given threshold in a month. Formula: COUNT(YearMonthConsumption > threshold) / COUNT(YearMonthConsumption) * 100. Inputs: YearMonthConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption; YearMonthDate = yearmonth.Date
aliases: percentage of customers consumed more than threshold
share of customers above consumption threshold

name: Country
definition: Countries where gas stations are located.

name: GasStationSegment
definition: Segments of gas stations.

name: Currency
definition: Currencies used by customers.
